lines.t: Verse 1
When the road is dark and I can’t see the way,
And my heart feels tired at the end of the day,
You whisper softly, “Child, just trust in Me,”
And suddenly the night begins to leave.
You calm the storm that’s raging in my soul,
You mend the broken pieces, make me whole.
(Chorus)
Your all I want, Your all I need.
Your my drink, my food indeed.
If I could have only You, I would be so glad.
You carry me when I am weak,
Uplift me when I am sad.
YahuShua, Your name is sweeter
Than honey in my mouth.
Following You is what my life is all about.
Oh, Lord. Your all I want.
Verse 2
My heart longs for You both night and day,
There’s nothing in this world that could take Your place.
When I am troubled and speak Your name, my worries flee.
You have always been there for me.
Your love is the light that guides my way,
And I will follow You every day.
(Chorus)
Your all I want, Your all I need.
Your my drink, my food indeed.
If I could have only You, I would be so glad.
You carry me when I am weak,
Uplift me when I am sad.
YahuShua, Your name is sweeter
Than honey in my mouth.
Following You is what my life is all about.
Oh, Lord. Your all I want.
Bridge
More than silver, more than gold,
More than all this world could hold,
You are the song playing in my heart,
From the end to the start.
(Final Chorus)
Your all I want, Your all I need,
My drink, my food indeed.
Forever I will be singing,
Your sweet melody.
Oh. Your all I want, Your all I need.
